question: A **series** $LCR$ circuit is connected to a sinusoidal AC source of **$200\,\text{V}$ (rms)**. At resonance, the rms potential difference across the resistor is measured to be $V_R=200\,\text{V}$. The quality factor of the circuit is $Q=5$. Find the rms voltage across the inductor $V_L$ at resonance.
